Measurement upgrade (objectui seat PM, session `session_017Qqyix2QcnpUC9XeYVDzx3`, 2026-08-10): the filer flagged this as a source read pending the deciding build. The **published-artifact reading settles it without a build** — inspected the npm tarballs directly:

- `@object-ui/fields@17.3.0` — `https://registry.npmjs.org/@object-ui/fields/-/fields-17.3.0.tgz` contains **zero `.css` files** (grep over the full `tar -tzf` listing). The `"./style.css": "./dist/index.css"` export is a phantom: a consumer's `@import '@object-ui/fields/style.css'` fails to resolve against the shipped package.
- Control: `@object-ui/components@17.3.0` tarball ships `package/dist/index.css` as expected.

So this is a real, user-visible defect in the published package, not a hypothesis. Consequence already acted on: PR #4060 (the #3883/#3884 docs sweep) was sent back for a targeted rework to stop teaching the fields import on all three guide pages — the docs half of this defect dies there; what remains for this card is the package half (either build real CSS for fields or remove the phantom export — and if fields' class shapes are not a subset of components' published utilities, removal alone under-styles fields, so the disposition needs that one measurement first).

Triage + release board (objectui seat PM — this repo's board producer): `pm:queue` + `target:v17`, class ② — the **published** `@object-ui/fields@17.3.0` package declares a `"./style.css"` export that resolves to nothing (zero `.css` files in the tarball, measured above): a shipped contract surface that lies. The docs half died in PR #4060; this card is the package half.

Claim: PM loop round 2
Session: `session_017Qqyix2QcnpUC9XeYVDzx3`
Branch: `claude/issue-4059-fields-style-export`
Worktree: `objectui-issue-4059`
Domain: `repo:objectui` (whole-repo seat)
File surface: `packages/fields/package.json` (exports), possibly `packages/fields` build config, + tests/gates pinning the disposition. ⛔ Region-exclusive vs the in-flight #3569 branch: do not touch `GridField*`/source component files in `packages/fields`. Stop on breach; explain in the report.
Container & model: M, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus`
Serial constraints cleared: #3569's pushed branch touches `packages/fields` **source** (`GridField.tsx`), disjoint from packaging/exports; no other claim or PR on `packages/fields` packaging.

**Delegated ruling with a falsifiable premise** (maintainer authorized seat rulings from the long-term-stability standpoint, 2026-08-10; veto window open):
- **Ruled route: retire the phantom export** (remove `"./style.css"` from `packages/fields`' exports + a gate asserting every declared subpath export resolves to a file that ships), **premised on**: fields' class shapes are a subset of the utilities already published in `@object-ui/components`' `dist/index.css`. The premise must be **measured first** (the #3884-style read: extract class-shaped tokens from fields' built `dist/*.js`, compare against components' published `dist/index.css` rule set).
- **If the premise is falsified** (fields has class shapes components' sheet does not carry): STOP — do not remove the export and do not silently switch to building CSS; report the fork with the measurement (the alternative is a real CSS build for fields, which is a product-shape call).
- Rationale: an export that has never resolved cannot have a working consumer, so removing it breaks no one and ends the lie; building CSS for a package with no CSS sources only makes sense if the subset premise fails.

## Ruling premise measured — **FALSIFIED**. No PR opened; the disposition is back with the PM.

The delegated ruling (retire the phantom export) was premised on: *fields' class shapes are a subset of the utilities already published in `@object-ui/components`' `dist/index.css`*. Measured first, per the instruction. It is not a subset.

### 1. The phantom export, confirmed three independent ways (on `origin/main` @ `0a09793f2`)

- Local build: `pnpm --filter @object-ui/fields build` -> exit 0, `find packages/fields/dist -name '*.css' | wc -l` = **0**.
- Published tarball `@object-ui/fields@17.3.0`: 274 entries, **zero** `.css`. Its `package.json` still declares `"./style.css": "./dist/index.css"`.
- Control `@object-ui/components@17.3.0`: ships `package/dist/index.css` (165 871 bytes).

### 2. Premise measurement (#3884's method)

Compiled fields' **built `dist/index.js` + `dist/index.cjs`** — the exact surface a `node_modules` glob can see — against components' own `@theme` (its `src/index.css`, with only the `@source` line repointed), then compared the produced rule set against components' **published** `dist/index.css` (downloaded tarball, not a local build).

| set | classes | selectors |
|---|---|---|
| fields' dist, scanned + compiled | 1510 | 1557 |
| `@object-ui/components@17.3.0` published `dist/index.css` | 1358 | 1411 |
| **in fields, NOT in components' published sheet** | **152** | **150** |

**Method control** (the same pipeline pointed at components' *own* dist, reproducing #3884's reading): **0 classes / 0 selectors missing** — 1358 vs 1358, i.e. components' pre-built CSS really is a strict superset of its own scan surface, exactly as #3884 measured. The pipeline is therefore validated, and the 152 are real.

Spot-traced to fields source, so these are not bundling artifacts:

| class | origin |
|---|---|
| `cursor-crosshair` | `packages/fields/src/widgets/SignatureField.tsx:113` |
| `group/email` | `packages/fields/src/index.tsx:1165` |
| `text-indigo-700` | `packages/fields/src/index.tsx:922` (tag colour map) |
| `min-w-[8ch]` | `packages/fields/src/widgets/TagsField.tsx:79` |
| `hover:fill-yellow-500` | `packages/fields/src/widgets/RatingField.tsx:83` |

### 3. The split that decides the fork

Of the 152, **17 depend on the ObjectUI `@theme` block**, which lives in `packages/components/src/index.css` and is **not published** (`files` ships `dist` only). No consumer-side `@source` can regenerate them — #3780 measured that grid already:

`bg-background/60`, `bg-destructive/5`, `bg-muted/60`, `bg-primary/20`, `border-background`, `border-border/40`, `border-muted-foreground/25`, `border-muted-foreground/30`, `focus-visible:ring-ring/60`, `focus:ring-ring/60`, `hover:bg-accent/30`, `hover:bg-muted/80`, `hover:bg-primary/10`, `hover:bg-primary/50`, `hover:border-primary/50`, `ring-border/60`, `ring-destructive/50`

The remaining **135** are plain Tailwind built-ins (palette, sizing, positioning) and *are* recoverable by an `@source` over `node_modules/@object-ui/fields/dist`.

### 4. Corroboration: no in-repo host relies on a pre-built fields sheet

Every host that renders fields reaches into fields' **source** instead — `apps/console/src/index.css:17`, `examples/console-starter/src/index.css:9`, `examples/byo-backend-console/src/index.css:29`, all `@source '.../packages/fields/src/**/*.{ts,tsx}'`. That is a workspace-relative path no external consumer can write. So the repo has never exercised the `./style.css` export, which is why the phantom survived — and it also means in-repo rendering proves nothing about consumer rendering.

### 5. Why removal alone is no longer a no-op

The ruling's rationale was "an export that has never resolved cannot have a working consumer, so removing it breaks no one". That still holds for the *export*. But it now collides with a second measured fact: after PR #4060, `content/docs/guide/quick-start.md:60` teaches

> That is the whole styling setup: you do not add `@source` lines for the ObjectUI packages, and pointing Tailwind at them inside `node_modules` only regenerates utilities the import already gave you.

That sentence is **true for components** (#3884 measured exactly that) and **false for fields**: it generalizes a components-only reading across the package boundary. A consumer following the current quick-start today gets **none of the 152**. Removing the export makes that the permanent, documented state with no supported remedy — which is a product-shape call, not a cleanup.

Reporting `needs_decision` with the A/B fork per the ruling's own escape clause. No files changed, no PR, worktree torn down.

**Delegated ruling #2 (objectui seat PM, session `session_017Qqyix2QcnpUC9XeYVDzx3`, 2026-08-10): the premise of ruling #1 is falsified by the measurement above — ruled route is now B, narrow variant.** Authorization: maintainer's 2026-08-10 delegation (decisions may be taken by this seat from the long-term-stability standpoint). Veto window open.

The dev's stop was correct and is the escape clause working as designed: 152 fields-only class shapes, 17 of them unrecoverable by any consumer-side `@source` (their `@theme` tokens are unpublished), falsify "removal breaks no one **and costs nothing**" — removal would ratify a permanently under-styled fields with no supported remedy.

**Ruling: B — give `@object-ui/fields` a real CSS build, narrow variant** (compile against `@object-ui/components`' theme, emit only fields' own utilities; do NOT re-emit the shared `@theme` — components' sheet owns it and consumers already import it first). Three axes:

1. **实际业务需求** — measured, not asserted: the 152 utilities style nine named shipped widgets (tag colours, signature crosshair, rating hover, tags sizing); fields' whole job is rendering inputs. The 17 theme-dependent ones have exactly one possible producer: the package itself.
2. **长远合理性/稳定性** — B is the existing `packages/components/scripts/build-css.mjs` pattern applied consistently, not a second mechanism; it is the only fork under which the published manifest tells the truth (same shape as the maintainer's #5175 ruling: when the capability and the declaration both exist, enforce — make the implementation catch up — rather than remove). A/A' both make "fields is styled" a property of consumer Tailwind configuration — the consumer-side-tolerance shape contract-first rejects.
3. **防 AI 犯错** — with B, one `@import` is correct by construction and the durable gate can land green asserting a true thing. A' fails as slightly-wrong colours even when transcribed perfectly — the least detectable failure mode available.

Startup-focus counterweight acknowledged (zero external reports since publication = weak pull); the cost side is one mirrored build script, which is why it does not tip the ruling.

**Implementation scope (same PR, per the dev's own note):**
- fields CSS build (narrow), export stays and becomes true; state in the PR how the coupling to components' unpublished `src/index.css` is expressed (build-time path is acceptable inside the monorepo — it mirrors how components builds itself);
- the durable gate lands in the SAME PR (extend `scripts/__tests__/package-files-exist.test.ts` with the producer test + `files`-containment test described in the report) — never before it, it would be red on main;
- docs alignment in the same PR: re-teach the fields `style.css` import where #4060 removed it, and correct the over-generalized sentence at `quick-start.md:60` — with B the measurement that justified the removal is superseded; docs must describe the package as it will ship from this commit;
- the changeset must say plainly that versions ≤17.3.0 never shipped this file (so the import only works from the release that carries this change).

**ACCEPT** (objectui seat PM, session `session_017Qqyix2QcnpUC9XeYVDzx3`, review of record) — PR #4076, implementing Delegated Ruling #2 (route B, narrow variant).

What shipped: `@object-ui/fields` gains a real CSS build — a build-time-only Tailwind entry that `@reference`s components' theme for resolution while emitting none of it, plus a build script mirroring components' that subtracts every rule components' built sheet already ships. Output 21.57 kB / 157 classes (vs a ~180 kB naive near-duplicate); `npm pack --dry-run` confirms `dist/index.css` is in the tarball — **the `"./style.css"` export resolves for the first time in the package's life**. Acceptance evidence per the ruling: all 152 measured fields-only classes covered, 0 uncovered, and all 17 theme-token utilities only this build can produce are present; the 157−152 delta is explained, not smoothed over. The durable gate (exports-reality: packability + CSS producibility) landed in the same PR in `package-files-exist.test.ts`, and the three guide pages were re-taught (fields import restored, the over-generalized quick-start:60 sentence repaired). Changeset minor, accepted by the Bump Policy gate.

Review notes: two real would-have-shipped-wrong bugs were caught by the dev's own verification — Tailwind's cwd-dependent source detection poisoning the subtraction set (fixed by reading components' built artifact) and fields' own entry absorbing repo-wide utilities (fixed with `source(none)`, byte-identical from both cwds); and the gate's first `onDisk` predicate was falsified against the exact state it exists to reject and re-keyed on git's index. Reverse verification ran in **both** pre-fix build states, red in both with the defect named verbatim in the failure message. Coupling to components' unpublished source is two build-time monorepo-relative paths, unreachable from the tarball, ordered by turbo's `^build`. Region exclusivity vs #3569 held. All 20 checks completed, 0 failures (Lint / Type Check / 4 shards individually verified).

Reminder recorded for the release: the export only works from the release that carries this change — versions ≤17.3.0 never shipped the file (stated in the changeset).

Landing next: flipping ready and driving to MERGED.
